//: tsconfig.json includes only src/**/* because it drives vite-plugin-dts,
which emits the published types/ output -- widening it there would risk
pulling bench-only types into the public declaration surface.
So the build config stays narrow and this one exists for checking. Without
it, `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` reports clean while never looking at
bench/ at all -- which is exactly how a real type error in
tests/** is deliberately NOT included yet: it currently has 32 pre-existing
type errors (mostly matrix_t vs Float32Array in the parity helpers), which
are a separate job from wiring up the check. Tracked separately -- widening
this include is the last step of that work, not the first.
